create_Window: create a Window instance with a title to draw a gridworld using Matplotlib
show_img_Window: show or update an image in the Window using the show_img method with a numpy array
set_caption_Window: set or update the caption text below the image using the set_caption method
reg_key_handler_Window: register a keyboard event handler callback function using the reg_key_handler method
show_Window: show the Window and start the event loop using the show method with optional blocking
